The Strong Survive#393.src: This doesn't seem right, {u}... Why would Commander Ferreo see that as an "opportunity"? What could that mean...
The Strong Survive#393.dst: 이건 뭔가 이상해요, {u}... Ferreo 사령관님은 왜 그걸 '기회'라고 본 거죠? 무슨 뜻일까...
The Strong Survive#393.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#394.src: We have to get down to the bottom of this. How about we confront Adder during lunch, and ask him what happened during his duel on the first day.
The Strong Survive#394.dst: 진상을 밝혀야 해요. 점심때 Adder한테 가서, 첫날 결투에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 물어보는 거 어때요?
The Strong Survive#394.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#395.src: But we need to get going now, I imagine Effal and the other recruits aren't happy waiting for us. Follow me, I'll lead you to the training room.
The Strong Survive#395.dst: 그래도 지금은 가야 해요. Effal이랑 다른 신병들이 기다리느라 짜증 났을 거예요. 따라와요, 훈련실로 안내할게요.
The Strong Survive#395.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#396.src: Go to your first challenge, then listen to the challenge instructions at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#396.dst: 첫 과제로 가서 [-{~}, {~}, {~}]에서 과제 설명을 들으세요.

The Strong Survive#397.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#397.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#398.src: All of the other recruits are probably in their challenge rooms right now.
The Strong Survive#398.dst: 다른 신병들은 지금쯤 다 과제실에 있을 거예요.
The Strong Survive#398.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#399.src: You should join them. Head to the endurance training room, it's the same one as yesterday.
The Strong Survive#399.dst: 합류하세요. 지구력 훈련실로 가요, 어제랑 같은 곳이에요.
The Strong Survive#399.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#400.src: Things aren't going to be as easy today, good luck!
The Strong Survive#400.dst: 오늘은 그렇게 쉽지 않을 거예요, 힘내요!
The Strong Survive#400.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#401.src: Well, it looks like we can start now that everyone's here.
The Strong Survive#401.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#402.src: Most of you did well on the first course, so we're going to be upping the difficulty this time. I trust that you're all ready.
The Strong Survive#402.dst: 대부분 첫 코스를 잘 해냈으니, 이번엔 난이도를 올리겠다. 모두 준비됐으리라 믿는다.
The Strong Survive#402.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#403.src: Make sure to watch where you're going, this course will have false platforms to trick you up if you're not paying attention.
The Strong Survive#403.dst: 어디로 가는지 잘 봐라. 이번 코스엔 가짜 발판이 있어서 방심하면 속는다.
The Strong Survive#403.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#404.src: Like before, you'll be judged based on how quickly you can complete the course and reach the exit.
The Strong Survive#404.dst: 이전처럼 코스를 얼마나 빨리 완주해 출구에 닿느냐로 평가한다.
The Strong Survive#404.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#405.src: I left the jump pad in here in case you want to get used to the feeling again. Enter the large door behind me to start the course when you're ready.
The Strong Survive#405.dst: 감을 되찾고 싶은 자를 위해 점프대는 여기 남겨 뒀다. 준비되면 내 뒤의 큰 문으로 들어가 코스를 시작해라.
The Strong Survive#405.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#406.src: Complete the first challenge of the day.

The Strong Survive#407.src: You realize your bad behaviour makes me look even worse for bringing you in, right?
The Strong Survive#407.dst: 네가 행실이 나쁘면 널 데려온 내가 더 한심해 보인다는 거 알지?
The Strong Survive#407.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#408.src: If I catch you sleeping in, going where you're not supposed to, or doing anything out of line again... You'll come to regret it...
The Strong Survive#408.dst: 또 늦잠을 자거나, 가면 안 될 곳에 가거나, 선을 넘는 짓을 하다 걸리면... 후회하게 될 거다...
The Strong Survive#408.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#409.src: I've been disgraced by my friends for getting ranked low yesterday... Now I don't feel like I have the will to do anything...
The Strong Survive#409.dst: 어제 순위가 낮다고 친구들한테 망신당했어... 이제 뭘 할 의욕도 없어...
The Strong Survive#409.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#410.src: D-Do you think I could regain their trust by getting a high ranking? No... I'm still not strong enough...
The Strong Survive#410.dst: 노, 높은 순위를 받으면 다시 믿어 줄까? 아니... 난 아직 그만큼 강하지 않아...
The Strong Survive#410.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#411.src: This is the challenge I did the best on yesterday. It should be mostly the same, hopefully. Slow and steady wins the race.
The Strong Survive#411.dst: 어제 제일 잘했던 과제예요. 대체로 비슷하면 좋겠네요. 느려도 꾸준하면 이겨요.
The Strong Survive#411.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#412.src: I'm not going to rush into these challenges like yesterday, I need time to think about what I am going to do.
The Strong Survive#412.dst: 어제처럼 과제에 무작정 뛰어들진 않을 거예요. 어떻게 할지 생각할 시간이 필요해요.
The Strong Survive#412.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#413.src: Took you a while to find your way here, did you get lost or something?
The Strong Survive#413.dst: 여기 찾아오는 데 한참 걸렸네. 길이라도 잃었나?
The Strong Survive#413.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#414.src: You're lucky Effal is a pushover, if you were in my group, you'd be out of here without a second thought.
The Strong Survive#414.dst: Effal이 물러서 운 좋은 줄 알아. 내 조였으면 두말없이 쫓겨났을 거다.
The Strong Survive#414.speaker: Recruiter Riva

The Strong Survive#416.src: Enter the next room and receive instructions for the next challenge.
The Strong Survive#416.dst: 다음 방에 들어가 다음 과제의 설명을 들으세요.

The Strong Survive#417.src: Not a bad time you had there. Keep this up and you might end up making me no longer regret letting you in here.
The Strong Survive#417.dst: 기록이 나쁘지 않군. 이대로만 하면 널 들인 걸 더는 후회 안 하게 될지도.
The Strong Survive#417.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#418.src: Up next is shield training, you're still not out of the woods yet. We are expecting big things from you.
The Strong Survive#418.dst: 다음은 방패 훈련이다. 아직 고비를 넘긴 건 아니야. 우린 너한테 큰 기대를 하고 있다.
The Strong Survive#418.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#419.src: Well... That was a disappointment. You've been given many second chances and this is what you do to give thanks>
The Strong Survive#419.dst: 음... 실망스럽군. 그렇게 여러 번 기회를 줬더니 고작 이렇게 보답하나>
The Strong Survive#419.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#420.src: If your mediocrity persists, I'll have no choice but to let you go, for both of our sake's. Now follow me to the next training room.
The Strong Survive#420.dst: 이렇게 계속 평범하면 우리 둘 다를 위해 널 내보낼 수밖에 없다. 이제 다음 훈련실로 따라와.
The Strong Survive#420.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#421.src: Hey {u}, I think the challenge went well. I managed to complete it at least, although I can't say for certain if I made a good time.
The Strong Survive#421.dst: 저기, {u}, 과제는 잘된 것 같아요. 적어도 완주는 했어요. 기록이 좋은지는 장담 못 하지만요.
The Strong Survive#421.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#422.src: I couldn't help but feel off about what the instructor said when I started the course... "Good luck Arnol... Not that it would matter...".
The Strong Survive#422.dst: 코스 시작할 때 교관이 한 말이 자꾸 마음에 걸려요... "행운을 빈다, Arnol... 소용없겠지만...".
The Strong Survive#422.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#423.src: What is that supposed to mean? I thought instructors were supposed to encourage us, helping us to do better in the training.
The Strong Survive#423.dst: 그게 무슨 뜻이죠? 교관은 우리를 격려하고 훈련을 더 잘하게 도와줘야 하는 거 아니에요?
The Strong Survive#423.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#424.src: I'm beginning to think that this training program is more about shaming us rather than preparing us to become soldiers. I wonder if the other recruits are starting to believe this as well...
The Strong Survive#424.dst: 이 훈련 과정이 우릴 병사로 준비시키는 게 아니라 망신 주려는 것 같다는 생각이 들기 시작했어요. 다른 신병들도 그렇게 느끼고 있을까요...
The Strong Survive#424.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#425.src: Welcome recruits to day two of your training in the shield challenge.
The Strong Survive#425.dst: 훈련 둘째 날 방패 과제에 온 걸 환영한다, 신병들.
The Strong Survive#425.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#426.src: I'll keep the summary short since I'm sure most of you remember the gist of the test from yesterday.
The Strong Survive#426.dst: 어제 시험의 요점은 대부분 기억하리라 믿으니 요약은 짧게 하겠다.
The Strong Survive#426.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#427.src: This time, instead of three turrets shooting at you, the number has been upped to five.
The Strong Survive#427.dst: 이번엔 포탑 세 개가 아니라 다섯 개가 너희를 쏜다.
The Strong Survive#427.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#428.src: On top of that, the three central turrets have been elevated. You'll have to aim your shield higher to block arrows coming from them.
The Strong Survive#428.dst: 게다가 가운데 포탑 세 개는 높이 올렸다. 거기서 오는 화살을 막으려면 방패를 더 높이 들어야 한다.
The Strong Survive#428.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#429.src: I've also adjusted the turret timings a little. Two turrets are now able to fire at you in quick succession, you must be ready to block the arrows from both of them.
The Strong Survive#429.dst: 포탑 발사 타이밍도 조금 조정했다. 이제 포탑 두 개가 연달아 쏠 수 있으니, 양쪽 화살을 모두 막을 준비를 해라.
The Strong Survive#429.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#430.src: I noticed that some of you struggled with lifting the shield on the first day...
The Strong Survive#430.dst: 첫날 방패를 드는 것조차 힘겨워한 자들이 있더군...
The Strong Survive#430.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#431.src: Perhaps those people would like some sort of crutch to help them perform better, but I must say that no such thing will be granted.
The Strong Survive#431.dst: 그런 자들은 더 잘하게 도와줄 보조 장치를 원하겠지만, 그런 건 절대 주지 않는다.
The Strong Survive#431.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#432.src: I believe that failure can be an excellent teacher. Some of you may still need to learn that failure should elicit a change from yourself.
The Strong Survive#432.dst: 난 실패가 훌륭한 스승이 될 수 있다고 믿는다. 너희 중엔 실패를 통해 스스로 달라져야 한다는 걸 아직 배워야 할 자도 있다.
The Strong Survive#432.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#433.src: For those recruits, until this lesson is fully learned, continued failure will be far more valuable than success.
The Strong Survive#433.dst: 그런 신병에겐 이 교훈을 온전히 배울 때까지, 계속되는 실패가 성공보다 훨씬 값질 것이다.
The Strong Survive#433.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#434.src: With that being said, I wish all of you lulck on the challenge! Pick up a shield on the rack next to Recruiter Ezero if you haven't.
The Strong Survive#434.dst: 그럼, 모두 과제에 행운을 빈다! 아직 방패가 없으면 Ezero 모집관 옆 걸이에서 가져가라.
The Strong Survive#434.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#435.src: Then, once you're ready, enter the large door behind me to start the test. Oh, and the training turret is still here if you need it.
The Strong Survive#435.dst: 준비되면 내 뒤의 큰 문으로 들어가 시험을 시작해라. 아, 연습용 포탑도 필요하면 아직 여기 있다.
The Strong Survive#435.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#436.src: Enter the next room and complete the second challenge.
The Strong Survive#436.dst: 다음 방에 들어가 두 번째 과제를 완수하세요.

The Strong Survive#437.src: Five turrets already? Seems like they're doing things a bit quicker than usual.
The Strong Survive#437.dst: 벌써 포탑 다섯 개? 평소보다 진도가 좀 빠른 것 같군.
The Strong Survive#437.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#438.src: Just don't look at it as increased difficulty, instead, look at it is an increased chance to show your might!
The Strong Survive#438.dst: 난이도가 올랐다고 생각하지 마. 네 힘을 보여 줄 기회가 늘었다고 생각해!
The Strong Survive#438.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#439.src: That wretch... Looking directly at me while he talks about failure...
The Strong Survive#439.dst: 저 비열한 놈... 실패 얘기를 하면서 저를 똑바로 쳐다보다니...
The Strong Survive#439.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#440.src: I'll make him eat those words... Maybe not today, but eventually... I'm done with letting people walk all over me!
The Strong Survive#440.dst: 그 말 도로 삼키게 해 줄 거예요... 오늘은 아니어도 언젠가는... 이제 짓밟히는 건 끝이에요!
The Strong Survive#440.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#441.src: Thank you for being here to listen to me, {u}, I don't know where I'd be right now without you...
The Strong Survive#441.dst: 제 얘기를 들어 줘서 고마워요, {u}. 당신이 없었으면 지금쯤 어떻게 됐을지...
The Strong Survive#441.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#442.src: After this, we'll meet in the cafeteria, and discuss what you saw last night with Adder.
The Strong Survive#442.dst: 이거 끝나면 식당에서 만나서, 어젯밤 Adder 일로 본 걸 얘기해요.
The Strong Survive#442.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#443.src: Heh... It seems like the instructor had a specific person here in mind when he talked about failures!
The Strong Survive#443.dst: 헤... 교관이 실패 얘기를 할 때 딱 한 사람을 염두에 둔 것 같던데!
The Strong Survive#443.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#444.src: When will Arnol realize he can't keep playing pretend soldier?
The Strong Survive#444.dst: Arnol은 병사 놀이를 계속할 수 없다는 걸 언제쯤 깨달을까?
The Strong Survive#444.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#445.src: Not this again... I think I can already guess how this will go for me...
The Strong Survive#445.dst: 또 이거야... 이번에 어떻게 될지 벌써 짐작이 가...
The Strong Survive#445.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#446.src: Do you think if I duck when the arrow comes, the instructor will count it as a block?
The Strong Survive#446.dst: 화살이 올 때 몸을 숙이면 교관이 막은 걸로 쳐 줄까?
The Strong Survive#446.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#447.src: Ah the shield challenge... Back when I was a recruit this test was the bane of many of my peers!
The Strong Survive#447.dst: 아, 방패 과제라... 내가 신병일 땐 이 시험이 동기들 골칫거리였지!
The Strong Survive#447.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#448.src: It was a lot different back then, yet it seeks that it's reputation hasn't changed much. Funny little coincidence I suppose.
The Strong Survive#448.dst: 그땐 방식이 꽤 달랐는데, 악명은 별로 안 변한 것 같군. 재밌는 우연이지.
The Strong Survive#448.speaker: Recruiter Ezero

The Strong Survive#449.src: Alright, {u}, stand on that plate in front of you to start the test.
The Strong Survive#449.dst: 좋아, {u}. 앞에 있는 발판에 서서 시험을 시작해라.
The Strong Survive#449.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#450.src: Good job recruit, exit through the door across from you.
The Strong Survive#450.speaker: Military Instructor

The Strong Survive#451.src: Leave the challenge room then talk to Arnol and Adder in the cafeteria at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#451.dst: 과제실을 나간 뒤 [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 식당에서 Arnol, Adder와 대화하세요.

The Strong Survive#452.src: You're all done now. Was the added difficulty too much? It seemed like it was for your friend Arnol, he stormed out after he finished.
The Strong Survive#452.dst: 이제 다 끝났군. 난이도가 너무 높았나? 네 친구 Arnol은 그랬나 보다. 끝나자마자 뛰쳐나갔어.
The Strong Survive#452.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#453.src: That's definitely not how a soldier should act, even I know that! Maybe you can teach him some manners at lunch.
The Strong Survive#453.dst: 병사가 할 행동은 절대 아니지, 나도 그 정도는 안다고! 점심때 네가 예의 좀 가르쳐 줘.
The Strong Survive#453.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#454.src: Anyway, you probably know the drill by now. Head up to the cafeteria and go enjoy your meal.
The Strong Survive#454.dst: 아무튼 이제 순서는 알겠지. 식당으로 올라가서 맛있게 먹어.
The Strong Survive#454.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#455.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#455.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#456.src: It's lunch time recruit, your food and the other recruits are in the cafeteria. It's the room to the left as soon as you enter the next room.
The Strong Survive#456.dst: 점심시간이에요, 신병. 식사와 다른 신병들은 식당에 있어요. 다음 방에 들어가자마자 왼쪽 방이에요.
The Strong Survive#456.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#457.src: Enjoy your meal, you deserve it!
The Strong Survive#457.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#458.src: That Wings recruit, Adder, do you know anything about him? Why did he refuse to sit with us?
The Strong Survive#458.dst: 그 날개 기사단 신병, Adder 말이야. 뭐 아는 거 있어? 왜 우리랑 안 앉겠다는 거지?
The Strong Survive#458.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#459.src: He seems like a complete nobody, I don't think he's from the {p} or Aelumia. I wouldn't bother with him, personally.
The Strong Survive#459.dst: 완전 무명 같던데. {p}이나 Aelumia 출신은 아닐 거야. 나라면 신경 안 써.
The Strong Survive#459.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#460.src: Well I didn't ask for your thoughts on the matter... I just want to know how a complete unknown like him was able to score higher than all of us!
The Strong Survive#460.dst: 네 생각은 안 물어봤는데... 그냥 저런 무명이 어떻게 우리 모두보다 점수가 높은지 알고 싶은 거야!
The Strong Survive#460.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#461.src: Two other have been expelled from our friend group... Will I be the next one to go?
The Strong Survive#461.dst: 우리 무리에서 벌써 둘이 쫓겨났어... 다음은 내 차례일까?
The Strong Survive#461.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#462.src: Oh... Dear Queen... Please give me the strength to do well in the training. I can't end up like the others!
The Strong Survive#462.dst: 오... 여왕 폐하... 훈련을 잘 해낼 힘을 주세요. 저 애들처럼 될 순 없어요!
The Strong Survive#462.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#463.src: How were you accepted into the Wings division? It's my goal here to be able to become a Wings soldier!
The Strong Survive#463.dst: 어떻게 날개 기사단에 뽑혔어? 난 여기서 날개 기사단 병사가 되는 게 목표야!
The Strong Survive#463.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#464.src: Well honestly, I'm not sure. I guess Recruiter Strumon just saw something in me? I was also stronger than my friends, so maybe that was it.
The Strong Survive#464.dst: 솔직히 잘 모르겠어. Strumon 모집관님이 나한테서 뭔가 보셨나? 친구들보다 힘이 세긴 했으니, 그래서일지도.
The Strong Survive#464.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#465.src: Hmmm... So if I can impress Recruiter Strumon then I might be able to make it into your group?
The Strong Survive#465.dst: 흐음... 그럼 Strumon 모집관님 눈에 들면 너희 조에 들어갈 수 있을까?
The Strong Survive#465.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#466.src: Well not exactly. Recruiter Strumon only accepts recruits. If you want to be promoted into the Wings division as an Aelumia soldier then you'd need to impress a Wings Commander, or Sovereign Majin...
The Strong Survive#466.dst: 꼭 그렇진 않아. Strumon 모집관님은 신병만 받으셔. Aelumia 병사로서 날개 기사단에 진급하고 싶으면 날개 기사단 사령관이나 Majin 군주님 눈에 들어야 해...
The Strong Survive#466.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#467.src: Darn... That sounds harder than I thought it'd be...
The Strong Survive#467.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#468.src: Did you speak to Recruiter Ollisy about your ranking from yesterday's training, what did she say?
The Strong Survive#468.dst: 어제 훈련 순위에 대해 Ollisy 모집관님과 얘기해 봤어? 뭐라셔?
The Strong Survive#468.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#469.src: She assured me that it was not that big of a deal, and I have lots of time to improve. I suppose I was being a bit overdramatic...
The Strong Survive#469.dst: 별일 아니니 걱정 말래. 나아질 시간은 충분하다고. 내가 좀 호들갑을 떨었나 봐...
The Strong Survive#469.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#470.src: In the Fruman military's eyes, we already passed the test. We're all going to be soldiers after the training, the ranking just encourages us to constantly improve.
The Strong Survive#470.dst: Fruma 군 입장에선 우린 이미 시험에 통과했어. 훈련이 끝나면 다 병사가 될 거고, 순위는 계속 발전하라고 독려하는 것뿐이야.
The Strong Survive#470.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#471.src: That's true, I will use my poor ranking as a reminder that I have much to improve on. I will make sure that today, my ranking will be higher!
The Strong Survive#471.dst: 맞아. 낮은 순위는 고칠 게 많다는 걸 일깨우는 걸로 삼을래. 오늘은 꼭 순위를 올릴 거야!
The Strong Survive#471.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#473.src: I've seen you and Arnol together a lot. I am confused with what you see in him. Is it because of his family name?
The Strong Survive#473.dst: 너랑 Arnol이 자주 같이 있더군. 그에게서 뭘 보는지 모르겠다. 가문 이름 때문인가?
The Strong Survive#473.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#474.src: If that is the case, I can assure you there are better options. Ones that will not hold you back.
The Strong Survive#474.dst: 그렇다면 더 나은 선택지가 있다고 장담하지. 너의 발목을 잡지 않을 자들 말이다.
The Strong Survive#474.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#475.src: So... This is how it feels to eat alone at lunch... I hate it...
The Strong Survive#475.dst: 그래서... 점심을 혼자 먹는 게 이런 기분이구나... 싫다...
The Strong Survive#475.speaker: Dogi

The Strong Survive#476.src: These challenges have been so difficult... I wonder if my performance will end up on my record, I hope not...
The Strong Survive#476.dst: 과제가 너무 어려워... 내 성적이 기록에 남을까? 안 남았으면 좋겠다...
The Strong Survive#476.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#477.src: Ha! What am I worried about, this is only the second day of a month of training! I'm sure I will get better before then.
The Strong Survive#477.dst: 하! 뭘 걱정하는 거야, 한 달 훈련 중에 겨우 이틀째인데! 그때까진 분명 나아질 거야.
The Strong Survive#477.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#478.src: This is my third serving, you really ought to take advantage of this buffet! Oh... I hope I don't get a cramp...
The Strong Survive#478.dst: 벌써 세 접시째야. 이 뷔페는 꼭 누려야 한다고! 아... 쥐 안 났으면 좋겠다...
The Strong Survive#478.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#479.src: Hey, wasn't there someone else in your group, what happened to them?
The Strong Survive#479.dst: 야, 너희 조에 한 명 더 있지 않았어? 걔 어떻게 됐어?
The Strong Survive#479.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#480.src: Eh? I'm not sure, they seemed really jumpy, my guess is they couldn't handle the pressure and wanted to go home.
The Strong Survive#480.dst: 응? 잘 모르겠어. 엄청 불안해 보이던데, 압박을 못 견디고 집에 가고 싶었나 봐.
The Strong Survive#480.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#481.src: Maybe you should take their example sis. I can tell already that you're struggling to keep up with everyone else!
The Strong Survive#481.dst: 누나도 걔 본받는 게 어때? 벌써 다른 애들 따라가느라 허덕이는 게 보이는데!
The Strong Survive#481.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#482.src: It seems like things are starting to look better for me in these challenges! Maybe if I keep this up, I can manage a spot in the top five!
The Strong Survive#482.dst: 과제에서 슬슬 잘 풀리는 것 같아! 이대로면 5위 안에 들 수도 있겠어!
The Strong Survive#482.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#483.src: Ah, you're here, {u}, come on, let's go ask Adder about how his duel went yesterday...
The Strong Survive#483.dst: 아, 왔군요, {u}. 자, Adder한테 어제 결투가 어땠는지 물어보러 가요...
The Strong Survive#483.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#484.src: Hey there, you're Adder right? I saw that you were first on the ranking yesterday, great job!
The Strong Survive#484.dst: 안녕, Adder 맞죠? 어제 순위 1등이던데, 대단해요!
The Strong Survive#484.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#485.src: and I were wondering how the duel went for you yesterday. We erm... Both did poorly on it and wanted to know how you won yours, just tell us what happened during the fight.
The Strong Survive#485.dst: 저희는 어제 당신 결투가 어땠는지 궁금했어요. 저희가 음... 둘 다 결투를 망쳐서, 어떻게 이겼는지 알고 싶거든요. 싸움에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 말해 줘요.
The Strong Survive#485.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#486.src: You want to know how my duel went yesterday? Well, when it started I didn't engage immediately, I wanted to gauge the strength of my opponent.
The Strong Survive#486.dst: 내 어제 결투가 어땠는지 알고 싶다고? 시작하자마자 달려들진 않았다. 상대의 실력을 가늠하고 싶었거든.
The Strong Survive#486.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#487.src: Despite leaving myself open for attack many times, my opponent couldn't even land a single hit on me. When I grew tired of that farse, I brutally retaliated...
The Strong Survive#487.dst: 일부러 여러 번 빈틈을 보였는데도 상대는 한 대도 못 맞혔지. 그 촌극에 질려서 가차 없이 반격했다...
The Strong Survive#487.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#488.src: Even after he was yelling for me to stop, yelling "I yield!" at the top of his lungs, I continued. People like that should not become soldiers.
The Strong Survive#488.dst: 그가 그만하라고, 목청껏 "항복한다!"고 외친 뒤에도 난 계속했다. 그런 자는 병사가 되어선 안 된다.
The Strong Survive#488.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#489.src: I stopped after he finally finished yelling, he had to be carried out by two guards. Commander Ferreo was watching the whole time, and did not intervene.
The Strong Survive#489.dst: 그가 마침내 비명을 멈춘 뒤에야 멈췄고, 그는 경비병 둘에게 실려 나갔다. Ferreo 사령관님은 내내 지켜보면서 개입하지 않으셨다.
The Strong Survive#489.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#490.src: You wanted to know how the duel went, that is how. He never should have been here in the first place, and I did the Fruman military a favour by making sure he will never come back.
The Strong Survive#490.dst: 결투가 어땠는지 알고 싶다 했지, 이게 전부다. 그는 애초에 여기 있으면 안 됐고, 다시는 못 돌아오게 해서 Fruma 군을 도운 거다.
The Strong Survive#490.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#491.src: You monster... He wanted to dedicate his life to serving the Queen and the people he loved, and you took that all away from him...
The Strong Survive#491.dst: 이 괴물... 그는 여왕 폐하와 사랑하는 사람들을 위해 평생을 바치려 했는데, 당신이 그걸 전부 빼앗았어요...
The Strong Survive#491.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#492.src: The will to do something means nothing, no matter how strong it is, if you do not have the ability to do it.
The Strong Survive#492.dst: 무언가를 하려는 의지는, 아무리 강해도 해낼 능력이 없다면 아무 의미 없다.
The Strong Survive#492.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#493.src: He would have just gotten himself killed, or worse, gotten others killed. What I did was serve Fruma to the best of my ability, I am no monster.
The Strong Survive#493.dst: 그는 자기만 죽거나, 더 나쁘게는 남까지 죽게 했을 거다. 난 힘닿는 데까지 Fruma를 섬겼을 뿐, 괴물이 아니다.
The Strong Survive#493.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#494.src: No true soldier would ever intentionally injure an ally... Let's go, this conversation is over.
The Strong Survive#494.dst: 진정한 병사는 절대 아군을 일부러 다치게 하지 않아요... 가요, 대화는 끝났어요.
The Strong Survive#494.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#496.src: Are you the one who told him to ask me about that? Who are you exactly?
The Strong Survive#496.dst: 그에게 그걸 물어보라고 시킨 게 너냐? 넌 대체 누구지?
The Strong Survive#496.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#497.src: Come sit next to me, I want to discuss what just happened.
The Strong Survive#497.dst: 제 옆에 앉아요. 방금 일에 대해 얘기하고 싶어요.
The Strong Survive#497.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#498.src: I expected the worst yet was still surprised by that... That fiend really did it on purpose, and Commander Ferreo let it happen...
The Strong Survive#498.dst: 최악을 예상했는데도 놀랐어요... 그 악당은 정말 일부러 그랬고, Ferreo 사령관님은 그걸 내버려 뒀어요...
The Strong Survive#498.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#499.src: I suppose we should talk about how the shield challenge went. That might end up making me angrier, but I should tell you...
The Strong Survive#499.dst: 방패 과제가 어땠는지 얘기해야겠죠. 더 화가 날지도 모르지만, 말해야 할 것 같아요...
The Strong Survive#499.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#500.src: I started the test, confident, ready to make that instructor eat his words, show him that I am not a failure. And I still couldn't block a single arrow.
The Strong Survive#500.dst: 자신만만하게 시험을 시작했어요. 그 교관이 말을 도로 삼키게, 제가 실패자가 아니라는 걸 보여 주려고요. 그런데 또 화살 하나도 못 막았어요.
The Strong Survive#500.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#501.src: He wouldn't even let me retry it, just told me to leave the room. I protested, I said that wasn't fair, but he insisted...
The Strong Survive#501.dst: 다시 해 보게 해 주지도 않고, 그냥 방에서 나가래요. 불공평하다고 항의했지만, 막무가내였어요...
The Strong Survive#501.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#502.src: And what about you, how did the shield challenge go?
The Strong Survive#502.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#503.src: That's great to hear, maybe you can show me how you did it sometime-
The Strong Survive#503.dst: 잘됐네요. 언제 어떻게 했는지 좀 보여 줘요-
The Strong Survive#503.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#504.src: I'm sorry to hear about that, we're in this together-
The Strong Survive#504.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#505.src: I-I was just wondering... No need to get-
The Strong Survive#505.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#506.src: Ah, you again... I've decided that I won't be going with you, I have done nothing to deserve such punishment, and will not stand to be treated like this.
The Strong Survive#506.dst: 아, 또 당신이군요... 따라가지 않기로 했어요. 이런 벌을 받을 짓은 한 적 없고, 이런 대우는 참지 않겠어요.
The Strong Survive#506.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#507.src: Don't talk to him like he's one of your servants, Arnol. Your family name means nothing here, if he asks you to go with him, you must go!
The Strong Survive#507.dst: 하인 대하듯 말하지 마라, Arnol. 여기서 네 가문 이름은 아무 의미 없다. 따라오라고 하면 따라가야 해!
The Strong Survive#507.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#508.src: This childish tantrum of yours will be noted. Now come with me before you start a scene. You are here to serve us, not the other way around.
The Strong Survive#508.dst: 이 유치한 투정은 기록해 두겠다. 소란 피우기 전에 따라와라. 네가 우릴 섬기러 온 거지, 그 반대가 아니다.
The Strong Survive#508.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#509.src: Wow, I didn't think Arnol had it in him to talk back to someone like that... Anyway, are you ready for dueling? Follow me.
The Strong Survive#509.dst: 와, Arnol이 그런 사람한테 대들 배짱이 있을 줄은 몰랐네... 아무튼 결투 준비됐나? 따라와.
The Strong Survive#509.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#510.src: Poor Arnol, he's going to become a soldier and yet he still can't control his temper tantrums.
The Strong Survive#510.dst: 불쌍한 Arnol, 병사가 될 거면서 아직도 성질을 못 다스리네.
The Strong Survive#510.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#511.src: What's next? Is he going to ask Commander Ferreo if he can change his diaper for him?
The Strong Survive#511.dst: 다음은 뭐야? Ferreo 사령관님한테 기저귀 좀 갈아 달라고 할 건가?
The Strong Survive#511.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#512.src: Head to the challenge room and recieve instructions for the final challenge of the day at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#512.dst: [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 과제실로 가서 오늘 마지막 과제의 설명을 들으세요.

The Strong Survive#513.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#513.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#514.src: If you're done with your lunch then wait for Recruiter Effal to pick you up for the next challenge in the cafeteria.
The Strong Survive#514.dst: 점심을 다 먹었으면 식당에서 Effal 모집관님이 다음 과제로 데리러 오길 기다려요.
The Strong Survive#514.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#515.src: And if Recruiter Effal already came to pick you and your group up then... you should be with him in the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#515.dst: Effal 모집관님이 이미 당신 조를 데리러 왔었다면... 지금쯤 결투실에서 함께 있어야 해요.
The Strong Survive#515.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#516.src: This will be the last of your training for today. Singular melee combat against another recruit.
The Strong Survive#516.dst: 이것이 오늘 마지막 훈련이다. 다른 신병과의 일대일 근접전이다.
The Strong Survive#516.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#517.src: The rules are the same as the day prior. Grab a training sword if you have not from the table and enter the large door when you are ready.
The Strong Survive#517.dst: 규칙은 전날과 같다. 훈련용 검이 없으면 탁자에서 챙기고, 준비되면 큰 문으로 들어가라.
The Strong Survive#517.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#518.src: I will be unable to oversee your challenges today as there is somthing I must attend to. I have asked another instructor to do so, they are waiting in the dueling rooms.
The Strong Survive#518.dst: 오늘은 처리할 일이 있어 과제를 감독할 수 없다. 다른 교관에게 맡겼으니, 결투실에서 기다리고 있을 거다.
The Strong Survive#518.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#519.src: Now go start the duels, good luck recruits.
The Strong Survive#519.dst: 이제 가서 결투를 시작해라. 행운을 빈다, 신병들.
The Strong Survive#519.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#520.src: Enter the next room and complete the final challenge of the day.
The Strong Survive#520.dst: 다음 방에 들어가 오늘의 마지막 과제를 완수하세요.

The Strong Survive#521.src: Remember not to take things too seriously here. Being a good soldier is not always about winning.
The Strong Survive#521.dst: 너무 심각하게 받아들이지 마라. 좋은 병사가 된다는 게 늘 이기는 것만은 아니다.
The Strong Survive#521.speaker: Recruiter Alena

The Strong Survive#522.src: Commander Ferreo wants to speak with you, don't keep him waiting.
The Strong Survive#522.dst: Ferreo 사령관님이 너와 얘기하고 싶어 하신다. 기다리시게 하지 마.
The Strong Survive#522.speaker: Recruiter Effal

The Strong Survive#523.src: Don't tell him I said this, but my brother, Robin, has the advantage over me in this challenge.
The Strong Survive#523.dst: 내가 이 말 했다고 하지 마. 이 과제에선 우리 오빠 Robin이 나보다 유리해.
The Strong Survive#523.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#524.src: As long as I never go up against him though, he won't realize that, that's why I am letting him go on ahead without me.
The Strong Survive#524.dst: 그래도 내가 오빠랑 붙지만 않으면 오빠는 그걸 모를 거야. 그래서 먼저 가라고 한 거지.
The Strong Survive#524.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#525.src: Maybe if I win against my opponent and he loses, he might be convinced that I am stronger!
The Strong Survive#525.dst: 내가 상대를 이기고 오빠가 지면, 내가 더 세다고 믿을지도 몰라!
The Strong Survive#525.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#527.src: I don't want you to start the duel yet, your opponent has yet to arrive. Let's wait together for him.
The Strong Survive#527.dst: 아직 결투는 시작하지 마라. 상대가 아직 오지 않았다. 함께 기다리지.
The Strong Survive#527.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#528.src: There you are, Arnol. I was told that you had an outburst during lunch. You will come to know that such things are unacceptable here.
The Strong Survive#528.dst: 왔군, Arnol. 점심때 소란을 피웠다고 들었다. 그런 일은 여기서 용납되지 않는다는 걸 알게 될 거다.
The Strong Survive#528.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#529.src: This is who you'll be dueling against Arnol. You two are friends, yes? Well this duel will surely teach both of you a valuable lesson.
The Strong Survive#529.dst: Arnol, 이자가 네 결투 상대다. 둘이 친구라지? 이 결투가 둘 모두에게 값진 교훈이 될 거다.
The Strong Survive#529.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#530.src: Valuable lesson? What is that supposed to mean Commander? Is this a trick? What is the point of me dueling my friend?
The Strong Survive#530.dst: 값진 교훈이요? 무슨 뜻이죠, 사령관님? 함정인가요? 친구와 결투해서 뭘 어쩌라는 거죠?
The Strong Survive#530.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#531.src: You should know better than to question the orders of your superior, Arnol. Now both of you, into the dueling room.
The Strong Survive#531.dst: 상관의 명령에 토를 달 만큼 어리석진 않을 텐데, Arnol. 이제 둘 다 결투실로 들어가라.
The Strong Survive#531.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#533.src: Step up, and the duel may begin. If either of you hold back, I will make you start the duel again, as many times as is needed.
The Strong Survive#533.dst: 앞으로 나서라, 결투를 시작한다. 둘 중 하나라도 봐주면, 필요한 만큼 몇 번이고 다시 시킬 거다.
The Strong Survive#533.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#534.src: You did better than expected Arnol. Yet the result was still what I imagined it would be.
The Strong Survive#534.dst: 예상보다 잘했다, Arnol. 하지만 결과는 여전히 내가 생각한 대로군.
The Strong Survive#534.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#535.src: Then what was the point of this duel, if you knew I would lose! Were you trying to humiliate me further? Haven't you done that enough already?!
The Strong Survive#535.dst: 제가 질 걸 아셨다면 이 결투는 대체 무슨 의미였죠! 저를 더 망신 주려고요? 이미 충분히 하지 않으셨나요?!
The Strong Survive#535.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#536.src: Your arrogance truly has no bounds. How many punishments will I have to give you until you start to take things here seriously?
The Strong Survive#536.dst: 네 오만함은 정말 끝이 없구나. 몇 번을 더 벌해야 여기 일을 진지하게 받아들이겠나?
The Strong Survive#536.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#537.src: You're becoming a lost cause, Arnol. Now go, there is something I would like to discuss with in private.
The Strong Survive#537.dst: 넌 구제불능이 되어 가고 있다, Arnol. 이제 가라. 따로 나눌 얘기가 있다.
The Strong Survive#537.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#538.src: Your kindness towards him is doing him no favour. Arnol must know what pain is like before he can become stronger, and your friendship is preventing that.
The Strong Survive#538.dst: 네 친절은 그에게 전혀 도움이 안 된다. Arnol은 강해지기 전에 고통을 알아야 하는데, 너희 우정이 그걸 막고 있다.
The Strong Survive#538.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#539.src: For both of your sakes, I insist you sever your bond with him.
The Strong Survive#539.dst: 둘 모두를 위해서, 그와의 관계를 끊어라.
The Strong Survive#539.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#540.src: Leave the dueling room, then go to the barracks to sleep at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#540.dst: 결투실을 나간 뒤 [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 병영으로 가서 잠자리에 드세요.

The Strong Survive#541.src: Do not take my advice for granted.
The Strong Survive#541.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#542.src: Am I the only one who is unimpressed with these challenges? They don't seem that related to being a soldier.
The Strong Survive#542.dst: 이 과제들이 시시한 건 나뿐이야? 병사가 되는 거랑 별 상관 없어 보이는데.
The Strong Survive#542.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#543.src: Eh, oh well. At least they're kind of fun, I'll give them that. I just wish the other recruits took them less seriously.
The Strong Survive#543.dst: 에이, 뭐 어때. 그래도 좀 재밌긴 하니까 그건 인정. 다른 신병들이 덜 심각하게 받아들였으면 좋겠어.
The Strong Survive#543.speaker: Kerry

The Strong Survive#544.src: Well done, you kept your promise to get a better ranking! I am sure Commander Ferreo and Recruiter Olissy are proud.
The Strong Survive#544.dst: 잘했어, 순위 올리겠다는 약속을 지켰네! Ferreo 사령관님도 Olissy 모집관님도 자랑스러워하실 거야.
The Strong Survive#544.speaker: Madelen

The Strong Survive#545.src: I used my shame from my first ranking as a driver to try harder on today's challenges. I am happy that I did poorly initially, because now I know must be constantly trying to improve!
The Strong Survive#545.dst: 첫 순위의 창피함을 원동력 삼아 오늘 과제에 더 힘썼어. 처음에 못했던 게 오히려 다행이야. 이제 늘 발전하려 애써야 한다는 걸 알았거든!
The Strong Survive#545.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#546.src: I will set the same promise now, tomorrow my ranking will be higher than it is now!
The Strong Survive#546.dst: 지금 같은 약속을 할게. 내일 내 순위는 지금보다 더 높을 거야!
The Strong Survive#546.speaker: Yvonne

The Strong Survive#547.src: I've failed... Now I'll never be able to become a Wings soldier...
The Strong Survive#547.dst: 실패했어... 이제 절대 날개 기사단 병사가 못 될 거야...
The Strong Survive#547.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#548.src: Don't you think you're being a bit over dramatic? I think you did great, it's not like you're at the bottom of the ranking.
The Strong Survive#548.dst: 좀 과장하는 거 아니야? 난 네가 잘했다고 생각해. 꼴찌도 아니잖아.
The Strong Survive#548.speaker: Saldin

The Strong Survive#549.src: Easy for you to say... You're already in the Wings group, you didn't have to work for anything, you were just born good! You'll never know what it's like to be a failure!
The Strong Survive#549.dst: 넌 말하기 쉽지... 넌 이미 날개 기사단 조고, 뭘 위해 노력할 필요도 없었어. 그냥 타고났잖아! 넌 실패자가 어떤 기분인지 절대 모를 거야!
The Strong Survive#549.speaker: Halbe

The Strong Survive#550.src: I can't believe we're done with the second day already. Enjoy being a recruit while it lasts, it won't get any easier from here.
The Strong Survive#550.dst: 벌써 둘째 날이 끝났다니 믿기지 않아. 신병일 때를 즐겨 둬. 앞으론 더 힘들어질 뿐이야.
The Strong Survive#550.speaker: Holger

The Strong Survive#551.src: You're on thin ice, Priscilla... You didn't improve at all from yesterday! What will people think if I let a weakling follow me around?
The Strong Survive#551.dst: 살얼음판이야, Priscilla... 어제보다 하나도 안 늘었잖아! 약골을 달고 다니면 사람들이 뭐라 생각하겠어?
The Strong Survive#551.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#552.src: Please Lynn! Just give me a second chance! I promise I will get into the top {~} tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#552.dst: 제발, Lynn! 한 번만 더 기회를 줘! 내일은 꼭 {~}위 안에 들게!
The Strong Survive#552.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#553.src: Make it top {~}! And if you fail... I'll never speak to you again!
The Strong Survive#553.dst: {~}위 안으로 해! 못 하면... 다시는 너랑 말 안 해!
The Strong Survive#553.speaker: Lynn

The Strong Survive#554.src: Top {~}!? That's... Eh... Fine, I will make it into the top {~} tomorrow, I promise!
The Strong Survive#554.dst: {~}위 안?! 그건... 어... 좋아, 내일 {~}위 안에 들게, 약속해!
The Strong Survive#554.speaker: Priscilla

The Strong Survive#555.src: Hey there recruit! Need help with anything?
The Strong Survive#555.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#556.src: You're done for the day, there are no challenges left.
The Strong Survive#556.dst: 오늘 일정은 끝났어요. 남은 과제는 없어요.
The Strong Survive#556.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#557.src: Now go get a well deserved rest. Head to the room straight across as soon as you enter the next room, and from there, enter the room to the left.
The Strong Survive#557.dst: 이제 푹 쉬어요, 그럴 자격 있어요. 다음 방에 들어가자마자 정면 맞은편 방으로 가서, 거기서 왼쪽 방으로 들어가요.
The Strong Survive#557.speaker: Secretary

The Strong Survive#559.src: You're not worth my time. Do me a favour and buzz off.
The Strong Survive#559.dst: 넌 내 시간을 쓸 가치가 없어. 부탁인데 저리 가.
The Strong Survive#559.speaker: Kyren

The Strong Survive#560.src: I am willing to put the incident at lunch today aside. You just need to tell me how you or Arnol discovered what happened in my duel on the first day.
The Strong Survive#560.dst: 오늘 점심 일은 덮어 둘 수 있다. 너나 Arnol이 첫날 내 결투에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 어떻게 알아냈는지만 말해라.
The Strong Survive#560.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#561.src: I'm not easily fooled, I don't buy the made up story that you two were looking for advice.
The Strong Survive#561.dst: 난 쉽게 속지 않는다. 너희가 조언을 구하러 왔다는 지어낸 얘기는 안 믿는다.
The Strong Survive#561.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#562.src: You should take this proposition seriously. I am not the type of person you would want as your enemy.
The Strong Survive#562.dst: 이 제안을 진지하게 받아들이는 게 좋을 거다. 난 적으로 두고 싶은 부류가 아니다.
The Strong Survive#562.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#563.src: It was a fluke, that's the only explanation of how you were able to beat me by one singular point! It means nothing!
The Strong Survive#563.dst: 요행이야. 네가 딱 1점 차로 날 이긴 건 그것밖에 설명이 안 돼! 아무 의미 없다고!
The Strong Survive#563.speaker: Robin

The Strong Survive#564.src: Right... Keep telling yourself that, but in the back of your mind you know that I beat you. I'll never make you forget that fact!
The Strong Survive#564.dst: 그래그래... 계속 그렇게 믿어. 그래도 속으론 내가 이겼다는 거 알잖아. 절대 잊게 두지 않을 거야!
The Strong Survive#564.speaker: Robyn

The Strong Survive#565.src: They've been at it for a while now. Which one do you think will beat the other tomorrow?
The Strong Survive#565.dst: 저 둘 한참째 저러네. 내일은 누가 이길 것 같아?
The Strong Survive#565.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#566.src: I'm not sure... What do you think will happen if they tie?
The Strong Survive#566.speaker: Matilda

The Strong Survive#567.src: I hope that doesn't happen, they would probably be up all night arguing about who's better.
The Strong Survive#567.dst: 그런 일은 없길 바라. 누가 더 나은지 밤새 싸울 테니까.
The Strong Survive#567.speaker: Wilton

The Strong Survive#568.src: Could this day have gone any worse?
The Strong Survive#568.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#569.src: The honourable Commander Ferreo did nothing as Adder beat a fellow recruit to a pulp...
The Strong Survive#569.dst: 명예로운 Ferreo 사령관님은 Adder가 동료 신병을 곤죽으로 만드는데도 가만히 있었어요...
The Strong Survive#569.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#570.src: The instructors of the esteemed {p} recruit program seem to have no interest in actually training us...
The Strong Survive#570.dst: 명망 높은 {p} 신병 과정의 교관들은 우릴 제대로 훈련시킬 생각이 없어 보여요...
The Strong Survive#570.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#571.src: And I am starting to doubt the idea of bringing honour to my house...
The Strong Survive#571.dst: 그리고 가문의 명예를 높인다는 생각도 의심스러워지기 시작했어요...
The Strong Survive#571.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#572.src: At least I'm not alone though...
The Strong Survive#572.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#573.src: Sneak around to find more information on Commander Ferreo's plans.
The Strong Survive#573.dst: 몰래 돌아다니며 Ferreo 사령관의 계획에 대한 정보를 더 찾으세요.

The Strong Survive#574.src: You found all of my diary entries, well done.
The Strong Survive#574.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#575.src: It's been so long since I've hid them, I was beginning to forget about them ever existing.
The Strong Survive#575.dst: 숨긴 지 워낙 오래돼서, 그런 게 있었다는 것도 잊어 가던 참이야.
The Strong Survive#575.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#576.src: Don't expect a medal or anything, I can answer some questions that you may have about them though.
The Strong Survive#576.dst: 훈장 같은 건 기대하지 마. 그래도 일기에 대해 궁금한 건 좀 답해 줄 수 있어.
The Strong Survive#576.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#577.src: It was Commander Ferreo's final insult. That's the reason I am here, as a guard in {p}.
The Strong Survive#577.dst: Ferreo 사령관의 마지막 모욕이었지. 그래서 내가 여기 {p}에서 경비병 노릇을 하는 거야.
The Strong Survive#577.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#578.src: After I graduated from the recruit program, my average rankings were seen as too low to join a field Captain or Commander's service.
The Strong Survive#578.dst: 신병 과정을 수료했을 때, 내 평균 순위는 현장 대장이나 사령관 밑에 들어가기엔 너무 낮았어.
The Strong Survive#578.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#579.src: So Ferreo himself stepped up and took me in, stationing me here to waste away. I think it's some form of punishment...
The Strong Survive#579.dst: 그래서 Ferreo가 직접 나서서 날 받아 주더니, 여기 배치해 썩게 뒀지. 일종의 벌인 것 같아...
The Strong Survive#579.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#580.src: I'm not sure to be quite honest. Maybe I was hoping for a sly recruit like yourself to find them, and not make the same mistakes I did.
The Strong Survive#580.dst: 솔직히 잘 모르겠어. 너처럼 눈치 빠른 신병이 찾아서 내 실수를 되풀이하지 않길 바랐는지도.
The Strong Survive#580.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#581.src: It may have just been out of boredom though. I can't remember what thoughts were going through my head back when I hid them, after I became a soldier.
The Strong Survive#581.dst: 그냥 심심해서였을 수도 있고. 병사가 된 뒤 그걸 숨길 때 무슨 생각을 했는지 기억이 안 나.
The Strong Survive#581.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#582.src: Deep down... Maybe I wanted Commander Ferreo to find those notes. I wonder what he would have though after reading them...
The Strong Survive#582.dst: 마음 깊은 곳에선... Ferreo 사령관이 그 기록을 찾길 바랐는지도 몰라. 읽고 나서 무슨 생각을 했을까...
The Strong Survive#582.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#583.src: I had a feeling you'd ask me that. And surprisingly, yes, I did discover the truth about Commander Ferreo's success. There is no secret. He did it all through a fierce determination to become greater.
The Strong Survive#583.dst: 그걸 물어볼 줄 알았어. 놀랍게도, 맞아, Ferreo 사령관이 성공한 진실을 알아냈어. 비밀 같은 건 없어. 더 위대해지겠다는 맹렬한 결의 하나로 해낸 거야.
The Strong Survive#583.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#584.src: When Commander Ferreo was young, he had nothing, he was a vagabond in {p}. Not living, just, surviving.
The Strong Survive#584.dst: Ferreo 사령관은 젊을 때 가진 게 없었어. {p}의 부랑자였지. 사는 게 아니라, 그냥 살아남는 거였어.
The Strong Survive#584.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#585.src: Sometimes the Fruman Military would come to visit, and everyone in the town gathered together to see them. Ferreo saw how everyone loved and praised them for their valiance.
The Strong Survive#585.dst: 가끔 Fruma 군이 찾아오면 마을 사람들이 다 모여 구경했어. Ferreo는 다들 그들의 용맹을 얼마나 사랑하고 칭송하는지 봤지.
The Strong Survive#585.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#586.src: He desperately wanted to be praised and loved like that too. So he made it his goal to reach that position, overcoming the countless obstacles in his way.
The Strong Survive#586.dst: 그도 그렇게 칭송받고 사랑받고 싶었던 거야. 그래서 그 자리에 오르는 걸 목표로 삼고, 앞을 막는 수많은 장애물을 넘었어.
The Strong Survive#586.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#587.src: Through sheer strength and expertise, he quickly became a Wings Commander, breaking military records in the process.
The Strong Survive#587.dst: 순전한 힘과 기량으로 금세 날개 기사단 사령관이 됐고, 그 과정에서 군 기록들을 갈아 치웠지.
The Strong Survive#587.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#588.src: There were rumours that he would push further and attempt to become a Sovereign, even though all the positions were full at the time...
The Strong Survive#588.dst: 그가 더 나아가 군주가 되려 한다는 소문도 있었어. 당시엔 그 자리가 전부 차 있었는데도...
The Strong Survive#588.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#589.src: He had finally reached the level of fame and admiration that he had set out for. But I imagine the potential for even greater heights tormented him.
The Strong Survive#589.dst: 마침내 그는 꿈꾸던 명성과 존경을 손에 넣었어. 하지만 더 높이 오를 수 있다는 가능성이 그를 괴롭혔겠지.
The Strong Survive#589.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#590.src: Not many know this, but just before he was given his current position, Commander Ferreo had a meeting with Sovereign Majin and The Queen.
The Strong Survive#590.dst: 아는 사람은 많지 않지만, 지금 직위를 받기 직전에 Ferreo 사령관은 Majin 군주와 여왕을 만났어.
The Strong Survive#590.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#591.src: We can only speculate at what the discussed, but quickly after said meeting, Majin appointed Commander Ferreo as head of {p}. My guess is that he was punished for his ambition...
The Strong Survive#591.dst: 무슨 얘기를 했는지는 짐작만 할 뿐이지만, 그 직후 Majin이 Ferreo 사령관을 {p}의 수장으로 임명했어. 내 추측으론 야심 때문에 벌을 받은 거야...
The Strong Survive#591.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#592.src: Good luck on your training recruit. I recommend you take it more seriously than I did.
The Strong Survive#592.dst: 훈련 잘 받아, 신병. 나보다는 진지하게 임하길 권해.
The Strong Survive#592.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#593.src: Sorry, but I still can't let you enter.
The Strong Survive#593.speaker: Niren

The Strong Survive#595.src: I grew suspicious of you when I heard you get up in the middle of the night yesterday to sneak around.
The Strong Survive#595.dst: 어제 한밤중에 네가 일어나 몰래 돌아다니는 소리를 듣고 의심하기 시작했다.
The Strong Survive#595.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#596.src: And somehow you were able to discover the results of my first duel... The only conclusion I can come to is that you have been spying on Commander Ferreo.
The Strong Survive#596.dst: 그리고 어째선지 내 첫 결투의 결과까지 알아냈지... 내릴 수 있는 결론은 하나, 네가 Ferreo 사령관님을 염탐해 왔다는 거다.
The Strong Survive#596.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#597.src: For this, you deserve to be exiled, executed, or imprisoned.
The Strong Survive#597.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#598.src: But... I have been looking to challenge myself, so far the training has been underwhelming. I would like to see what a resistance spy is capable of.
The Strong Survive#598.dst: 하지만... 난 도전할 상대를 찾고 있었다. 지금까지 훈련은 시시했지. 저항군 첩자가 얼마나 하는지 보고 싶군.
The Strong Survive#598.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#599.src: If you can best me in a duel, I won't report you to Commander Ferreo. The first person to land {~} hits on the other shall be declared the victor.
The Strong Survive#599.dst: 결투에서 날 이기면 Ferreo 사령관님께 보고하지 않겠다. 먼저 상대에게 {~}번 적중시키는 쪽이 승자다.
The Strong Survive#599.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#600.src: As a show of good faith, I will let you land the first hit on me.
The Strong Survive#600.dst: 성의의 표시로 첫 일격은 맞아 주지.
The Strong Survive#600.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#601.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry particles, Adder will swipe his estoc at you. Perfect blocking this attack will stun him, allowing you to counterattack.
The Strong Survive#601.dst: 끙 소리와 분노 입자가 보이면 Adder가 에스톡을 휘두릅니다. 이 공격을 완벽히 막으면 기절시켜 반격할 수 있습니다.
The Strong Survive#601.speaker: Swipe

The Strong Survive#602.src: Telegraphed by a grunt without angry particles, Adder will hop to the side.
The Strong Survive#602.dst: 분노 입자 없이 끙 소리만 나면 Adder가 옆으로 뜁니다.
The Strong Survive#602.speaker: Sidestep

The Strong Survive#603.src: Telegraphed by a grunt and angry and blue particles, Adder will lunge forward and charge with his estoc. This attack deals damage twice, once at the start and once at the peak of the lunge. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#603.dst: 끙 소리와 분노 입자, 파란 입자가 보이면 Adder가 에스톡을 겨누고 앞으로 돌진합니다. 이 공격은 돌진 시작과 정점에서 한 번씩, 두 번 피해를 줍니다. 마지막 타격을 완벽히 막으면 기절시킬 수 있습니다.
The Strong Survive#603.speaker: Lunge

The Strong Survive#604.src: Telegraphed by angry and green particles, Adder will continuously swipe his estoc in front of him while running towards the {u} for several seconds. Perfect blocking the last hit will stun him.
The Strong Survive#604.dst: 분노 입자와 초록 입자가 보이면 Adder가 몇 초 동안 {u}에게 달려오며 앞쪽으로 에스톡을 연달아 휘두릅니다. 마지막 타격을 완벽히 막으면 기절시킬 수 있습니다.
The Strong Survive#604.speaker: Swipe Chain

The Strong Survive#605.src: Absurd... Even after everything I have been through, I still am not strong enough...
The Strong Survive#605.dst: 말도 안 돼... 그 모든 걸 겪고도 난 아직 강하지 않다니...
The Strong Survive#605.speaker: Adder

The Strong Survive#607.src: Make your way through the vents.

The Strong Survive#608.src: We've found ourselves in a terribly difficult situation, Strumon...
The Strong Survive#608.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#609.src: We have a spy amongst our recruits and know who they are, yet that messenger expects us to not do anything about it until Sovereign Majin gets here!?
The Strong Survive#609.dst: 신병 중에 첩자가 있고 누군지도 아는데, 그 전령은 Majin 군주님이 오실 때까지 아무것도 하지 말라니!?
The Strong Survive#609.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#610.src: I think it is important to be cautious here Commander, if this spy is as powerful as the messenger implied... This could spell the end for all of us...
The Strong Survive#610.dst: 사령관님, 지금은 신중해야 한다고 봅니다. 그 첩자가 전령 말대로 강하다면... 우리 모두 끝장날 수도 있습니다...
The Strong Survive#610.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#611.src: Yes, you're probably right. Nevertheless, once Sovereign Majin arrives and sees that I let a spy into the recruit program... I fear that all that I have worked for will be lost...
The Strong Survive#611.dst: 그래, 네 말이 맞겠지. 하지만 Majin 군주님이 오셔서 내가 첩자를 신병 과정에 들였다는 걸 아시면... 내 모든 노력이 물거품이 될까 두렵다...
The Strong Survive#611.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#612.src: I will not give up so easily, nor will I do nothing while we wait for Sovereign Majin to arrive...
The Strong Survive#612.dst: 이대로 쉽게 포기하진 않겠다. Majin 군주님을 기다리며 손 놓고 있지도 않을 거다...
The Strong Survive#612.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#613.src: I want Effal to be exiled to Wynn immediately for treason. He let the spy in, and must be punished for that. Find a guard to replace his position as Recruiter, anyone would be more competent than him.
The Strong Survive#613.dst: Effal을 반역죄로 즉시 Wynn에 추방해라. 첩자를 들였으니 그 대가를 치러야 한다. 모집관 자리엔 경비병 아무나 앉혀. 누구라도 그놈보단 유능할 거다.
The Strong Survive#613.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#614.src: Relay this to the other guards and recruiters. Effal should be out of Fruma by tomorrow!
The Strong Survive#614.dst: 이 명을 다른 경비병과 모집관들에게 전하라. Effal은 내일까지 Fruma를 떠나야 한다!
The Strong Survive#614.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#615.src: Now, Commander, there is another issue I would like to bring up with you, the reason why I came to your office this late into the night in the first place.
The Strong Survive#615.dst: 그리고 사령관님, 말씀드릴 문제가 하나 더 있습니다. 애초에 이 늦은 밤에 집무실로 찾아온 이유입니다.
The Strong Survive#615.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#616.src: Your plan yesterday went along perfectly. I checked in with the doctor and he told me Katze will need to be sent home.
The Strong Survive#616.dst: 어제 계획은 완벽하게 진행됐습니다. 군의관에게 확인했더니 Katze는 집으로 보내야 한답니다.
The Strong Survive#616.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#617.src: Excellent, tomorrow Adder will duel against Arnol. His family name can no longer make up for his weakness!
The Strong Survive#617.dst: 훌륭하다. 내일 Adder를 Arnol과 결투시켜라. 가문 이름으로 그 나약함을 더는 덮을 수 없을 거다!
The Strong Survive#617.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#618.src: Commander... Is this really the best option? The spy seems to have grown a liking towards Arnol. I fear doing this could trigger a retaliation from them...
The Strong Survive#618.dst: 사령관님... 정말 이게 최선입니까? 첩자가 Arnol에게 호감을 가진 것 같습니다. 이러다 보복을 부를까 두렵습니다...
The Strong Survive#618.speaker: Recruiter Strumon

The Strong Survive#619.src: Does upsetting a single cursed one really frighten you that much, Strumon? Besides, I expect Sovereign Majin will have arrived by then, your concerns are unfounded.
The Strong Survive#619.dst: 저주받은 자 하나 화나게 하는 게 그렇게 두렵나, Strumon? 게다가 그때쯤이면 Majin 군주님이 도착하실 테니 괜한 걱정이다.
The Strong Survive#619.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#620.src: Commander, Recruiter, there is an urgent matter that requires attending to. Please, follow me!
The Strong Survive#620.dst: 사령관님, 모집관님, 처리하셔야 할 급한 일이 있습니다. 저를 따라오십시오!
The Strong Survive#620.speaker: Military Guard

The Strong Survive#621.src: Unscrew the vent, then head back to the barracks to wake Arnol at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
The Strong Survive#621.dst: 환기구 나사를 푼 뒤, [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 병영으로 돌아가 Arnol을 깨우세요.

The Strong Survive#623.src: What is this about, {u}? Why are you waking me up so early in the morning?
The Strong Survive#623.dst: 무슨 일이에요, {u}? 왜 이렇게 새벽같이 깨워요?
The Strong Survive#623.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#624.src: What!? I'd stand no chance against Adder! He might even end up killing me if I face him! I guess I should have expected Commander Ferreo would do something like this though...
The Strong Survive#624.dst: 뭐라고요!? 전 Adder한테 상대도 안 돼요! 붙었다간 죽을지도 몰라요! 하긴 Ferreo 사령관이 이런 짓을 할 거란 건 예상했어야 했는데...
The Strong Survive#624.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#625.src: If you're telling me this now, you must have some idea on how to help me with this mess. What is your plan, {u}?
The Strong Survive#625.dst: 지금 이걸 알려 준 걸 보면, 이 난장판에서 절 도울 방법이 있겠죠. 계획이 뭐예요, {u}?
The Strong Survive#625.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#626.src: Hmmm... Ok, I trust you. Let's go before anyone wakes up.
The Strong Survive#626.dst: 흐음... 좋아요, 믿을게요. 아무도 깨기 전에 가요.
The Strong Survive#626.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#627.src: Hmmm... Ok, I'll go with you.
The Strong Survive#627.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#629.src: Escape through the Tericen entrance at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

The Strong Survive#630.src: We're leaving through the main entrance? What if a guard spots us?
The Strong Survive#630.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#631.src: Alright, I'll try to stay close.
The Strong Survive#631.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#633.src: Weird... There seems to be no guards on duty...
The Strong Survive#633.dst: 이상하네... 근무 중인 경비병이 하나도 없어요...
The Strong Survive#633.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#637.src: Where are you off to? I don't remember dismissing either of you.
The Strong Survive#637.dst: 어딜 가나? 둘 다 가도 좋다고 한 기억은 없는데.
The Strong Survive#637.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#638.src: I would have thought that by now you'd both know insubordination isn't tolerated here. Neither is treason...
The Strong Survive#638.dst: 이쯤이면 둘 다 알 줄 알았다. 여기선 불복종을 용납하지 않는다. 반역도 마찬가지고...
The Strong Survive#638.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#639.src: Does Arnol know you're a spy? Imagine what his family would think, if they found out he's conspiring with the resistance.
The Strong Survive#639.dst: Arnol은 네가 첩자인 걸 아나? 그가 저항군과 공모한다는 걸 가족이 알면 어떻게 생각할지 상상해 봐라.
The Strong Survive#639.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#641.src: I'll let them deal with him. But you... the responsibility of prosecuting you has been lended to me.
The Strong Survive#641.dst: 그는 가족에게 맡기겠다. 하지만 너는... 너를 처단할 책임이 내게 주어졌다.
The Strong Survive#641.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#643.src: There is no hope for you or your kind in Fruma!
The Strong Survive#643.dst: Fruma에 너와 너 같은 것들을 위한 희망은 없다!
The Strong Survive#643.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#644.src: I've never lost a duel, don't fool yourself into thinking I'd let you change that!
The Strong Survive#644.dst: 난 결투에서 져 본 적이 없다. 네가 그걸 바꾸게 둘 거라 착각하지 마라!
The Strong Survive#644.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#645.src: I won't die here! Not to the likes of you!
The Strong Survive#645.speaker: Commander Ferreo

The Strong Survive#647.src: That's enough Commander, you're clearly outmatched.
The Strong Survive#647.dst: 그만해요, 사령관. 상대가 안 되는 게 뻔하잖아요.
The Strong Survive#647.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#648.src: Thank you... For looking out for me after everything, even though you had no reason to...
The Strong Survive#648.dst: 고마워요... 그 모든 일 뒤에도 절 챙겨 줘서요. 그럴 이유도 없었는데...
The Strong Survive#648.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#649.src: I've spent my whole life drifting, aimless... But now I know what my purpose is, thanks to you...
The Strong Survive#649.dst: 평생 목적 없이 떠돌았어요... 하지만 이제 제 목적이 뭔지 알아요. 당신 덕분에요...
The Strong Survive#649.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#650.src: My purpose is to make sure that tyrants like Commander Ferreo meet their just end. It seems like this may be your goal as well.
The Strong Survive#650.dst: 제 목적은 Ferreo 사령관 같은 폭군이 마땅한 최후를 맞게 하는 거예요. 당신의 목표도 그런 것 같네요.
The Strong Survive#650.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#651.src: I must go out on my own now, I hope that one day we meet again. I promise you I'll be stronger by then!
The Strong Survive#651.dst: 이제 혼자 떠나야 해요. 언젠가 다시 만나길 바라요. 그때까진 더 강해져 있을게요!
The Strong Survive#651.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#652.src: I was raised to believe that the cursed ones were wicked, yet you've been nothing but helpful. Seems like that was just another lie...
The Strong Survive#652.dst: 저주받은 자는 사악하다고 배우며 자랐는데, 당신은 도움만 줬어요. 그것도 또 하나의 거짓말이었나 봐요...
The Strong Survive#652.speaker: Arnol

The Strong Survive#653.src: Are you a recruit as well? You certainly look strong. I imagine you must have a lot of experience.
The Strong Survive#653.dst: 당신도 신병이에요? 확실히 강해 보이네요. 경험이 많겠죠.
The Strong Survive#653.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#654.src: I am a bit newer to this than you, but I may still be able to offer you some insights if you're curious.
The Strong Survive#654.dst: 난 당신보다 좀 신참이지만, 궁금하다면 그래도 몇 가지 알려 줄 수 있어요.
The Strong Survive#654.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#655.src: Well... A carriage rode me halfway to {p}, then it broke down and I had to walk the rest of the way. When I finally arrived the King himself was there to greet me and made me a recruit.
The Strong Survive#655.dst: 음... 마차 타고 {p}까지 반쯤 왔는데, 고장 나서 나머진 걸어왔어요. 겨우 도착하니 왕이 직접 맞아 주시고 신병으로 삼아 주셨죠.
The Strong Survive#655.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#656.src: I can't seem to remember anything before that though... It probably wasn't too important, what's important is my new job as a recruit!
The Strong Survive#656.dst: 그 전 일은 하나도 기억이 안 나지만... 별로 중요하진 않았겠죠. 중요한 건 신병이라는 새 일이니까요!
The Strong Survive#656.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#657.src: I wonder if the King will give me a promotion soon...
The Strong Survive#657.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#658.src: No... I can't say I have ever seen you before... Are you a fan or something?
The Strong Survive#658.dst: 아뇨... 당신을 본 기억은 없는데요... 혹시 팬이에요?
The Strong Survive#658.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#659.src: I didn't imagine having fans already but that's great! I'm already on the path of becoming the most famous person in Wynn!
The Strong Survive#659.dst: 벌써 팬이 생길 줄은 몰랐는데, 잘됐네요! 난 벌써 Wynn에서 제일 유명한 사람이 되는 길을 걷고 있어요!
The Strong Survive#659.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#660.src: Waiting? I'm not waiting for anything! I'm just resting... That's all!
The Strong Survive#660.dst: 기다리냐고요? 아무것도 안 기다려요! 그냥 쉬는 중이에요... 그게 다예요!
The Strong Survive#660.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#661.src: It's tiring doing so much work out there. Plus I need to give the other recruits and guards a chance to prove themselves, I shouldn't hog all of the glory!
The Strong Survive#661.dst: 밖에서 일을 너무 많이 해서 피곤하거든요. 게다가 다른 신병이랑 경비병한테도 증명할 기회를 줘야죠. 영광을 독차지하면 안 되잖아요!
The Strong Survive#661.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#662.src: You don't need to worry about me, I'll be fine out there. Just because you look stronger doesn't mean I'm weak!
The Strong Survive#662.dst: 내 걱정은 안 해도 돼요. 밖에서 잘 지낼 거예요. 당신이 더 강해 보인다고 내가 약한 건 아니라고요!
The Strong Survive#662.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#663.src: You're the one who should be worried... Worried about me surpassing you of course!
The Strong Survive#663.dst: 걱정해야 할 건 당신이에요... 물론 내가 당신을 앞지를까 봐서요!
The Strong Survive#663.speaker: Effal

The Strong Survive#664.src: But hey, we're on the same side, so let's both keep fighting out there! For the King!
The Strong Survive#664.dst: 그래도 우린 같은 편이니, 밖에서 둘 다 계속 싸워요! 왕을 위하여!
The Strong Survive#664.speaker: Effal
